instruction: Please help me install the Prettier code formatter extension in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the Prettier code formatter extension (esbenp.prettier-vscode) in VS Code. Evaluator verifies installation by checking if 'code --list-extensions' output contains the extension ID. Uses existing is_extension_installed metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Shell command syntax error: The command array ['code', '--list-extensions', '|', 'grep', 'esbenp.prettier-vscode'] treats pipe '|' and 'grep' as literal arguments, not shell operators
Missing 'shell: true' parameter in the result config, which is required for pipe and grep to work correctly
The command will likely fail at runtime or return unexpected results because shell operators won't be interpreted
The evaluator logic is otherwise sound: correct extension ID, appropriate metric function (is_extension_installed with 'contain' rule), and complete coverage of the instruction requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add '"shell": true' to the result config in evaluator.result to enable shell interpretation of pipes and grep
Alternative fix: Simplify the command to just ['code', '--list-extensions'] without pipe/grep, since the is_extension_installed metric already performs containment checking
Verify the command works by testing: either use shell mode with the full pipeline, or use simple command listing with metric-based filtering
